turns.q: Where can I find your full shipping policy?
turns.replyTail:
What I can confirm is:
We currently ship only to the UK and Channel Islands.
Shipping options and final costs are shown at checkout for your delivery address.
UK delivery is free on orders over £60.
Orders under £60 have a £4.50 UK shipping charge.
Unfolded is made to order, so production starts after you place your order and dispatch can take longer than typical ecommerce orders.
You can find the estimated shipping date on each product page after selecting a size and scrolling down.
